_comment: English-only UI strings that are not in the D4 resource file. Not translated: Zaka does not invent translations. Other locales fall back to these until native reviewers supply them.
english_only_note: Some screens are still in English while translations are reviewed.
auth_switch_to_signin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth_demo_note: Synthetic demo data — not a real person.
auth_check_email: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth_offline: You need a connection to sign in the first time.
consent_body: Zaka uses the money details you enter to show your cash-flow estimate and explain possible risks. You can correct or delete your entries. If you ask Zaka to check a message, the text may be processed by our AI service; remove PINs, one-time codes and account details first. Zaka does not move money or decide whether you qualify for credit. Continue only if you agree.
consent_points_1: Your entries are private to your account.
consent_points_2: We never ask for your PIN, OTP or banking password.
consent_points_3: You can delete everything from the Me screen.
onb_money_hint: Cash in your pocket plus what's in the bank. A rough number is fine.
onb_income_hint: Pick all that apply. We'll also learn from your entries.
onb_per_week: About how many times a week?
onb_costs_hint: We pre-fill what we can. Change any number to your own.
onb_ob_day: Day of the month it's due
mode_bus: Bus (MyCiTi, Rea Vaya, A Re Yeng…)
type_it_hint: e.g. got R350 from a piece job
type_it_fallback: Filled in on this phone. Check the details.
type_it_failed: I couldn't understand that. Try: got R350 from a piece job
queued: Saved on this phone — will sync when you're online.
shortfall_moved: Your tight day moved from {from} to {to}.
shortfall_cleared: No shortfall predicted in the next 14 days now.
conf_why_low: Fewer than 14 days or 6 entries so far.
conf_why_high: {days} days of history, {count} entries, and a pattern seen 3+ times.
safe_none: Nothing safe to spend before {date}. Essentials come first.
tight_body: At this pace your money may run out before the next money arrives. Add expected money or change a payment to update this.
ins_monthly_income: Your {source} of about {amount} usually arrives around the {day}th — seen {count} times.
ins_recurring_weekly: {source} of about {amount} usually comes on {weekday}s — seen {count} times.
ins_piece_jobs: You get about {perWeek} piece jobs a week, usually around {amount}.
ins_tight_day: Money is usually tightest around the {day}th of the month.
ins_busy_weekday: {weekday} is usually your biggest spending day (about {amount}).
ins_shortfall_gap: About {amount} more over the next 14 days would cover the gap from {date}.
plan_horizon_income: Horizon ends at your next likely money ({source}, {date}).
plan_horizon_cap: No likely money in the next 14 days, so we plan for all 14.
plan_low_path_note: Low path: likely money counted at half, possible money not counted. Every number is an estimate you can change.
goal_daily: Put away about {amount} a day to reach it by {date}.
scam_intro: Paste an SMS, WhatsApp or email. Zaka checks it for common warning signs on this phone first.
scam_low_body: That does not mean it is safe. If it asks for money or details, verify it yourself first.
scam_explain_failed: We couldn't get an explanation right now. The warning signs above still apply.
scam_not_stored: Your message is not saved. We only keep which warning signs were found.
flag_otp_pin: Asks for a PIN, OTP or password
flag_upfront_fee: Asks you to pay a fee first
flag_impersonation: Claims to be SASSA, a bank or an official body
flag_personal_info: Asks for ID, card or account details
loan_intro: Enter the lender's written terms. Zaka adds them up in rands.
loan_within_limit: The interest is within the legal maximum rate for this credit type.
loan_rights: A lender may never keep your SASSA card, bank card or ID.
me_delete_confirm: This deletes your account and every entry. It cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.
me_reset_demo_note: Puts Lerato's 10 synthetic weeks back, ending today.
me_about_body: Zaka is built by JustIT Solutions. All maths is done by code on your phone and is shown in "Why this estimate?". AI is only used to read a sentence you type and to explain scam warning signs.
me_offline_cache: Works offline: your last plan and new entries are kept on this phone.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Your entries are safe on this phone.
logout_pending: {count} entries are still waiting to sync and will be lost if you log out now. Log out anyway?
loan_type_credit_facility: Credit card, store card or overdraft
loan_cap_year: Legal maximum: {rate}% a year (repo rate {repo}% plus the margin set in law).
loan_simple_interest_note: Interest here is worked out on the full amount for the whole term. If you pay back in instalments, your quote may be lower.
loan_rate_needed: Enter the interest rate from the written quote to compare it with the legal maximum.
loan_init_above: The initiation fee is above the legal maximum of {max} for this loan.
loan_init_within: The initiation fee is within the legal maximum of {max}.
loan_service_above: The monthly service fee is above the legal maximum of {max}.
loan_service_within: The monthly service fee is within the legal maximum of {max}.
loan_legal_source: National Credit Regulations 42 and 44; repo rate from the SARB. Checked {date}.
help_own_number: Use a number you find yourself — never one from the message.
help_use_saps: Report a crime or give a tip-off (24 hours)
help_use_obs: If your bank doesn't resolve your complaint
help_other_banks: Other banks: use the number on the back of your card or in the official app.
bd_low_day: Kept back for the lowest day
bd_set_aside: Set aside for goals and later bills
count_cash_body: Count your cash and check your bank balance. Enter the total and Zaka records the difference as a balance correction.
count_cash_diff_in: Zaka will add a balance correction of +{amount}.
count_cash_diff_out: Zaka will add a balance correction of −{amount}.
big_amount_confirm: That's a big amount: {amount}. Is it right?
err_amount_zero: The amount must be more than R0.
err_amount_too_big: That's more than R1,000,000. Please check the amount.
err_text_too_long: That's too long. Please shorten it.
err_text_no_letters: Please use words, not only symbols or numbers.
auth_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.

auth_cooldown: Too many tries. Try again in {n} seconds.
auth_rate_limited: Too many tries right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth_signup_failed: We couldn't create that account. If you already have one, sign in instead.
auth_terms_pre: By creating an account you agree to our
err_typed_long: That's too long. Keep it under 200 characters.
err_date_too_old: Entries can go back to 1 January 2024.
err_date_too_far: That's more than 7 days ahead. Please check the date.
err_scam_short: Paste the whole message (at least 10 characters).
err_scam_long: That's too long. Paste up to 2,000 characters.
err_scam_no_words: Paste a message with words, not only emoji or symbols.
err_rate_limited: Too many entries in a minute. Please wait and try again.
loan_ranges: Amount R100 to R1,000,000 · interest 0–100% a month or 0–1,000% a year · term 1–360 months · fees R0 or more.
err_bill_day: Choose a day from 1 to 31. A bill on the 31st is due on the last day of shorter months.
privacy_who_b: Zaka is made by JustIT Solutions (Pty) Ltd (2026/025680/07), Pretoria, South Africa. We are registered with the Information Regulator. Our Information Officer is Phenyo Matlou. Contact: support@jis-tech.co.za.
privacy_collect_b: Your email and password (stored as a secure hash) so you can sign in. The money details you enter (amounts, categories, dates, notes, bills, goals and settings) so Zaka can show your plan. For Scam Shield we keep only the risk level and which warning signs were found, never the message. We count AI requests to stop abuse, without their content.
privacy_never_b: We never ask for or store your bank PIN, one-time passwords (OTPs) or banking logins. Zaka does not connect to your bank and never moves money. If you set an app PIN, it stays on your phone as a scrambled code and is never sent to us.
privacy_ai_b: When you use Type it or ask Scam Shield to explain a message, that text is sent to Anthropic (Claude, United States) to produce the answer. We do not save the text. Remove PINs, codes and account numbers before you paste a message. All money maths is done by code on your phone, not by AI.
privacy_where_b: Your account and entries are stored with Supabase in London, United Kingdom, protected so only you can read them. Your phone keeps a copy so Zaka works offline; logging out removes it.
privacy_keep_b: Until you delete it. Me → Delete my data removes your account and every entry at once. The shared demo account holds only made-up data.
privacy_rights_b: You may see, correct or delete your information, and object to how we use it. Email support@jis-tech.co.za. You may also complain to the Information Regulator: inforegulator.org.za.
privacy_advice_b: Zaka gives estimates from the details you enter. It is not financial, credit or legal advice, and it does not decide whether you qualify for credit. Check important decisions with a qualified adviser.
notfound_body: The link may be old or mistyped. Your money plan is safe.
feedback_quote: You may quote my comment (no name)
feedback_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback helps us make Zaka better.
feedback_limit: You've sent feedback 3 times today. Thank you!
feedback_failed: We couldn't send that right now. Please try again later.
share_message: I'm using Zaka to plan my money: it shows what's safe to spend until my next money comes in. Try it:
pin_body: For shared phones. Zaka asks for the PIN when it opens and after 5 minutes away. The PIN stays on this phone only.
pin_weak: That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid 1234, 0000, 1212 and the like.
pin_mismatch: The PINs did not match. Please start again.
pin_set: PIN set. Zaka will ask for it on this phone.
pin_wait: Too many wrong tries. Wait {n} seconds.
pin_wait_short: Too many wrong tries. Please wait a moment.
pin_wiped: Too many wrong tries. For your safety Zaka signed out and cleared this phone.
pin_forgot: Forgot your PIN? Sign in again with your password
auth_signup_done: Done. If this email is new, your account is ready (check your email if we ask you to confirm). If you already have an account, use its password. Tap Sign in to continue.
